info.title: AngularUnitTests.Cli
info.description: Angular Unit Test Generator - CLI tool for generating unit tests for Angular components, services, guards, and resolvers

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Angular Unit Tests CLI - Generate Jest unit tests for Angular TypeScript files

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate Jest unit tests for Angular TypeScript files

options.name: --path
options.description: A TypeScript file or a folder to generate tests for. A folder is scoped to that folder and its subfolders; a file generates a spec for that file only. If not provided, generates tests for the current directory and its subdirectories (must be within an Angular workspace).

options.name: --overwrite
options.description: Overwrite an existing .spec.ts in place (default). Pass --overwrite false to instead preserve existing specs and write .spec.2.ts, .spec.3.ts, …

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Delete all generated .spec.ts files in a folder and its subfolders

options.name: --path
options.description: The folder to clean. All .spec.ts files in this folder and its subfolders are deleted (excluded directories such as node_modules are skipped). If not provided, the current directory is used.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: List the .spec.ts files that would be deleted without deleting anything.
